features.name: Theme Studio
features.author: VoidCraft Launcher
features.description: Choose a separate launcher-wide color palette and preview supported theme presets.
capabilities: Apply colors to supported launcher UI screens
features.dataUse: Applies colors to supported launcher screens only; it does not alter Minecraft's renderer.

features.name: Server Status
features.author: VoidCraft Community
features.description: Check a Java Edition server's online/offline state, server icon, MOTD, current/max players, and version.
capabilities: HTTPS lookup of an entered Minecraft server host
Save server entries in app-private storage
features.dataUse: Refresh sends the entered host to the HTTPS status provider. The saved list remains local.

features.name: Community Resources
features.author: VoidCraft Community
features.description: A dedicated screen of links to mod discovery and launcher project resources.
capabilities: Open HTTPS resource links when tapped
features.dataUse: The feature itself stores no personal data; a chosen external website receives normal request metadata.

features.name: Social Hub (Preview)
features.author: VoidCraft Launcher
features.description: Mobile-first profile, friend-request, friend-list, remove-friend and chat interface. Local preview only; online delivery and external sign-in are not connected.
capabilities: Save local profile, friend request, friend and chat preview data
features.dataUse: Social Hub is local-only. Requests and messages are not delivered online; provider credentials or tokens are not stored.

features.name: Performance Advisor
features.author: VoidCraft Launcher
features.description: Review device memory, storage, ABI and thermal conditions and get cautious pre-launch suggestions. Does not edit game settings or measure live FPS.
capabilities: Read basic device environment and thermal statistics
features.dataUse: Reads a local pre-launch snapshot. Does not upload device data, change Minecraft options or measure reliable live FPS.

features.name: Device Compatibility Report
features.author: VoidCraft Launcher
features.description: Review Android version, CPU ABIs, memory and storage while separating device facts from unverified Minecraft, Java, mod and renderer compatibility.
capabilities: Read basic device model, Android API, CPU ABI, memory and storage statistics
features.dataUse: Measurements are displayed locally and are not uploaded automatically.

features.name: Storage Inspector
features.author: VoidCraft Launcher
features.description: See internal-storage availability and the size of Feature Store private files. Does not claim to include inaccessible game or world files.
capabilities: Read internal-storage statistics
Measure Feature Store private files
features.dataUse: Measures accessible storage metadata locally and does not read or upload world contents.

features.name: Launcher Scratchpad
features.author: VoidCraft Launcher
features.description: Keep private notes, commands and checklists for your launcher workflow. Copy or delete notes at any time.
capabilities: Save and manage user-entered local records in app-private storage
features.dataUse: User-entered records stay local unless explicitly copied out. No automatic online sync or upload.
